g.text: FLEX: 3V3 -> flex sensor -> FLEXn node -> 10k -> GND. The ESP32 reads the node voltage (ADC1).

g.desc: FLEX: 3V3 -> flex sensor -> FLEXn node -> 10k -> GND. The ESP32 reads the node voltage (ADC1).

g.text: The 100 nF from each node to GND smooths the reading.

g.desc: The 100 nF from each node to GND smooths the reading.

g.text: Each sensor plugs into a 2-pin JST-XH socket (J1-J5). Either way round works.

g.desc: Each sensor plugs into a 2-pin JST-XH socket (J1-J5). Either way round works.

g.text: FLEX1-5 = GPIO 39, 34, 35, 32, 33: the same order as FLEX_PINS[] in hand_sign_glove_ble.ino.

g.desc: FLEX1-5 = GPIO 39, 34, 35, 32, 33: the same order as FLEX_PINS[] in hand_sign_glove_ble.ino.

g.text: GPIO39 is the DevKit pin named SENSOR_VN (printed VN on the board).

g.desc: GPIO39 is the DevKit pin named SENSOR_VN (printed VN on the board).

g.text: IMU: MPU6050 module (GY-521) on I2C. SDA = GPIO21, SCL = GPIO22. AD0 to GND = address 0x68.

g.desc: IMU: MPU6050 module (GY-521) on I2C. SDA = GPIO21, SCL = GPIO22. AD0 to GND = address 0x68.

g.text: The module has its own I2C pull-up resistors, so the carrier has none.

g.desc: The module has its own I2C pull-up resistors, so the carrier has none.

g.text: POWER: USB on the DevKit. J6 is an optional 5 V input to the DevKit EXT_5V pin.

g.desc: POWER: USB on the DevKit. J6 is an optional 5 V input to the DevKit EXT_5V pin.

g.text: Use USB or J6, never both at once. 3V3 comes from the DevKit's regulator.

g.desc: Use USB or J6, never both at once. 3V3 comes from the DevKit's regulator.

g.text: PWR_FLAG is not a part. It only tells KiCad's rule check that the net has a supply.

g.desc: PWR_FLAG is not a part. It only tells KiCad's rule check that the net has a supply.

g.text: Pins marked X are unused. H1-H4 are M3 mounting holes.

g.desc: Pins marked X are unused. H1-H4 are M3 mounting holes.

g.text: MPU6050 under the DevKit on the PCB

g.desc: MPU6050 under the DevKit on the PCB
